mapper.select: select log_id, device_id, sn, product_id, sync_content, sync_status, command_type, create_time, remark from pms_device_sync_log where sn = #{sn} and sync_status = '2' order by log_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into pms_device_sync_log (device_id, sn, product_id, sync_content, sync_status, command_type, create_time, remark) values (#{deviceId}, #{sn}, #{productId}, #{syncContent}, #{syncStatus}, #{commandType}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update pms_device_sync_log set sync_status = #{syncStatus}, remark = #{remark} where log_id = #{logId}
